scope: Focused libuv executable-path and loop controls on an empty guest filesystem; no upstream Node startup or new SpiderMonkey runtime evidence

contract.name: uv_exepath
contract.size: Input capacity; output bytes excluding terminator. Upstream successful truncation is preserved.
contract.errors: UV_EINVAL for null pointers/zero capacity; actual guest readlink errno otherwise. One-byte capacity succeeds with an empty terminated path.
contract.ownership: Synchronous borrowed caller buffer; no callback or retained pointer. Actual guest process owns the executable lease.
contract.nativeConsumer: Environment initialization snapshots the path before callbacks; native argument/epoch/ownership accessors remain compile-only
contract.javascriptConsumer: Original process patch/pre_execution normalization remains unchanged
remainingValidation: upstream Node startup on current engine
